definition: AI systems designed to recognize, interpret, or simulate human emotional expression, whether through text, voice, or facial analysis.
details: Emotional AI (sometimes called affective computing) is applied in areas like customer service, mental health support tools, and human-computer interaction research, alongside ongoing ethical debate about appropriate use cases.
